title: FAA UAP reports, batch 05 (237UAP00107 - 237UAP00131)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings by commercial and general aviation pilots between August and November 2022.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported 2-3 blinking lights steady over LIT at high altitude.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported as 2 and 3 blinking lights at an altitude well above FL390 steady over LIT.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported pulsating lights orbiting above the horizon.
incidents.quote: a series of white and orange pulsating lights appeared to be orbiting above the horizon

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a flashing light well above their altitude.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was 1 flashing light 100NM N of BNA

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a single light that would shine and fade repeatedly.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was a single light that would shine for 3-4 minutes then fade.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported three distinct targets behaving unexpectedly.
incidents.quote: 3 distinct well-lit targets behaving not as the pilot would expect with satellites.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported multiple bright yellow glowing lights.
incidents.quote: multiple bright yellow glowing lights alternating in brightness and number.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported flare-like lights traveling at high altitude.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported as flare like or bright lights traveling E bound at high altitude.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a light that turned off while traveling north.
incidents.quote: the UFO then proceeded to turn its light off and continue north bound.

incidents.summary: Multiple reports of UFO activity maneuvering aggressively at various altitudes.
incidents.quote: multiple reports of UFO activity in and around the Toledo and Detroit areas

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a sea of flashing white lights below their altitude.
incidents.quote: described as a sea of flashing white lights below their altitude.

incidents.summary: ATCT observed a jellyfish-like object with flashing lights.
incidents.quote: described as having flashing green/red/blue lights and looking like a jelly fish

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a high-speed object passing between aircraft.
incidents.quote: traveling W bound at a high rate of speed between their aircraft and the other two aircraft

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported lights moving in different directions near the constellation Leo.
incidents.quote: multiple lights moving in different directions, left of the constellation Leo.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported twinkling lights described as a celestial phenomenon.
incidents.quote: twinkling lights traveling from low on the horizon to high on the horizon

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported blue/white lights moving from low to high on the horizon.
incidents.quote: blue/white lights traveling from low on the horizon to high on the horizon.

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported five white twinkling lights in the distance.
incidents.quote: five white twinkling lights traveling above and in the distance.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a manned jetpack hovering.
incidents.quote: manned jetpack hovering at approximately 8,000 feet.

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported three bright lights in a triangular shape moving erratically.
incidents.quote: 3 bright lights in a triangular shape moving in an erratic motion

incidents.summary: Ground observer reported an amber glowing sphere moving at high speed and ascending.
incidents.quote: observed from the ground an amber glowing sphere moving at a high rate of speed

incidents.summary: Multiple aircraft reported white lights circling at high altitude.
incidents.quote: 2-3 white lights circling at approximately FL740.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported bright rotating lights traveling at high speed.
incidents.quote: bright rotating lights about the size of a C172 traveling at a high rate of speed

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported stationary lights that disappeared and reappeared.
incidents.quote: appeared as aircraft landing lights and was stationary 30 degrees above the horizon.
